title: One HP Too Many
spec: Get an enemy down to exactly one health point. Your next attack is almost ready—but the enemy lands its final hit first.

title: Someone Got There First
spec: Run toward the last piece of quest firewood. Just before your collection bar finishes, another player picks it up and it disappears.

title: The Merge Conflict Surprise
spec: Finish a major coding task and try to push it. The push is rejected. Pull the latest changes and discover merge conflicts throughout your carefully finished work.

title: The Wasp Beside the Open Door
spec: Open the door wide to let a wasp out. It repeatedly bumps into the closed glass panel immediately beside the enormous opening.

title: Roadworks on Every Route
spec: Follow a diversion around roadworks. Turn onto the alternative route and find another road closure. The next detour leads to temporary traffic lights.

title: The Song on Every Station
spec: Change the radio station to escape an irritating song. The next station is playing it too. Switch again and land on the chorus.

title: The Squeaky Chair
spec: Sit down in a quiet room. The chair squeaks whenever you shift your weight. Try to find a comfortable position that makes no noise.

title: The Renovation Holiday
spec: Begin your holiday and settle in for a peaceful morning. Drilling starts next door at eight. The clock advances through eight hours of renovation noise.

title: The Festival Toilet Queue
spec: Join a long toilet queue. After slowly reaching the corner, discover that the line continues around it and stretches much farther than you thought.

title: Only the Black Sweets Left
spec: Share a bag of sweets with a friend. Reach for your favorite color, but they take the last one. Only the black sweets remain.

title: Rush to Wait
spec: Hurry to a medical appointment and arrive just in time. Sit down in the waiting room. The clock advances forty minutes while your name remains uncalled.

title: The Keyboard Consultation
spec: Start explaining your symptoms. The doctor keeps typing without looking up. You pause, wondering whether they are listening. The typing continues.

title: One Minute Early
spec: Reach the bus stop a minute before the scheduled departure. Watch your bus disappear down the road. The display changes to “Next bus: 20 min.”

title: Advertisements Everywhere
spec: Your program cuts to advertisements. Change channels and find more advertisements. Keep switching until you return to the original channel—still on advertisements.

title: The Recorded Sports Overrun
spec: Open the film you scheduled your recorder to save. It contains a sports broadcast that ran late. Skip forward until the recording ends before the film begins.

title: The Sudden Disconnect
spec: Play normally with no warning signs. Everything freezes mid-action. A moment later, “Connection lost” appears and you are returned to the menu.

title: The Tape Edge Hunt
spec: Rotate a roll of transparent tape until you find the edge. Lift it carefully, and only a narrow strip peels away. The rest stays stuck to the roll.

title: The Expanding Fingerprint
spec: Notice a fingerprint on your glasses and wipe it with a cloth. The small mark spreads into a greasy haze across the entire lens.

title: Caps Lock at Login
spec: Carefully type a long password into a hidden field. “Incorrect password.” Reveal the characters and discover that Caps Lock has reversed every letter’s case.

title: The Remote Just Out of Reach
spec: Find the missing remote behind the sofa. Reach down and touch it with your fingertips. Your attempt to grab it pushes it farther underneath.

title: The Final Screw
spec: Assemble some furniture and tighten the final screw. The screwdriver slips, damaging the screw head. Every further attempt slips out of the same shallow groove.

title: The Sock Outside the Wash
spec: Load the washing machine, close the door, and start the cycle. The door locks. Look down and spot one forgotten sock beside your foot.

title: The Pen That Only Works on Scrap Paper
spec: Try to write on a card, but the pen produces nothing. Scribble on scrap paper and it works perfectly. Return to the card, and the ink stops again.
